## Description {#details}

<p>Elf_Verdaux: This is the structure of auxiliary data in the SHT_GNU_verdef section (.gnu.version_d).</p>


<p>This structure is identical for ELF32 and ELF64.</p>


<p>Definition at line 321 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/object/elftypes-h">ELFTypes.h</a>.</p>
